$comment: Measured mobile values for the Senior-Saving reference listicle. Captured 2026-07-03 at viewport 390x844 (Playwright Chrome, CSS px, overlay scrollbar 0px), URL https://senior-saving.com/10-benefits-nb-hw-safe, after document.fonts.ready + settle. Full-page height 12621px. Companion capture: reference-mobile.png. IMPORTANT: the live page has DRIFTED from the section-30.1 desktop baseline (font family Inter not Arial, header #e0072b not #ce2e35, headline 36px h2 not 38px h1, radius 8px not 5px, body 18px not 20px) — see 'Live-page drift register' in reference-layout-audit.md. These mobile values are internally coherent with the 2026-07-03 live page state, NOT with the stale top-page baseline.

logo.note: h-10 w-auto — NOT downscaled at 390px; same rendered size as desktop

disclosureTrigger.interaction: same dropdown panel as desktop (see tokens.ts disclosureInteraction)

headline.element: mobile-only <div class='text-2xl py-1'><strong> variant; the desktop h2 pair is hidden below 640px (sm)
headline.note: each of the 2 authored headline lines wraps to 2 rendered lines at 390px (glyph rows at y=89/121/161/193, 29.5px glyph boxes, 32px pitch within a div, 40px across divs)

byline.note: text 'Nathan Lorance | Advertorial | Updated: Jul 3, 2026' — the Updated date is dynamic (renders the current date); mask/parametrize in visual regression

bodyParagraph.note: identical to live desktop values — no mobile downscale; provisional 18px/27px corrected to 18px/30px

sectionHeading.element: h3 inside <a> (linked to the offer URL)
sectionHeading.numberBadge: ALL headings start with a numbered badge span: bg #d1d5db, paddingX 6px, borderRadius 8px, inline-flex, marginRight 6px, lineHeight 24.6px
sectionHeading.note: same classes as desktop (only lg: variants exist, no sm:); wraps to 2 lines at 390px. Section 6's heading alone sits in 'hidden sm:block' with no mobile counterpart and renders NO heading at 390px

sectionImage.note: does NOT match the hero (2:1, radius 8px)

choiceButtonGroup.columnsAt390: 1 column for the 6-button and 3-button groups (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3); 2 columns for the 2-button and 4-button groups (grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-2)
choiceButtonGroup.note: page has 6 sections; the counts belong to sections 1,2,3,4,6 — section 5 has no choice-button group. Each button is wrapped in a block <a>; a full-width button-styled <a> CTA follows each group (my-2 flex justify-center)

textCta.display: inline within the closing paragraph ('… ➝ Check Eligibility Here')

legalDisclosureBlock.position: between the last section divider and the footer
